sections.A: GBS mein immune system achanak peripheral nerves par hamla karta hai, aksar infection ke baad. Peripheral neuropathy (jaise diabetes mein) dheere dheere nerves ka nuqsan hai.
sections.B: GBS: dinon se hafton mein pairon se upar charhti dono taraf ki kamzori aur reflexes khatam; sab se bara khatra saans ki muscles.
sections.C: GBS: haal ka infection, kamzori kitni tez barh rahi, saans aur nigalne ki takleef. Neuropathy: diabetes, sharab aur sunn-pan.
sections.D: GBS mein vital capacity aur ek saans mein ginti se saans ki kamzori pakrein; neuropathy mein sensation aur balance.
sections.G: Tezi se upar charhti kamzori, girti vital capacity, kamzor khansi ya nigalne mein masla: emergency.
sections.H: GBS: shuru mein saans ki nigrani, seene ki care, positioning aur splints; phir dheere dheere taaqat bina zyada thakan ke. Neuropathy: balance, taaqat aur pair ki hifazat.
sections.M: GBS: vital capacity, MRC sum score, disability scale aur chalna. Neuropathy: balance aur girne ka risk.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. GBS ka sab se khatarnak shuru ka masla saans ki nakami hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
